title: Vermont AI Laws

reading.body:
Vermont's only AI-related law governs synthetic media in elections, not AI development, data centers, or grid demand.

The law, S0023, passed on 2026-03-10, requires disclosure on deceptive and fraudulent synthetic media published within 90 days before an election. It sets format requirements for images, video, and audio, provides penalties for knowing and intentional violations, and gives the Attorney General and State's Attorneys enforcement and investigation powers. Candidates can seek injunctive relief.

For AI specifically, this is a narrow case. It regulates a use of generated media at the point of political speech, and it does not touch model training, compute procurement, or the physical infrastructure that this site treats as the binding constraint on scaling. A single election-integrity statute says nothing about how much power Vermont data centers draw or how quickly they can be connected.

The data covers one enacted law and its enrolled text. It does not show pending bills, failed bills, or any non-AI legislation that might still affect compute or power in the state. One law is also too small a sample to describe a regulatory posture.

Vermont has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Vermont

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • S0023: An act relating to the use of synthetic media in elections passed 2026-03-10

    This act requires a disclosure on synthetic media that is deceptive and fraudulent when published, communicated, or distributed within 90 days before an election in Vermont. It sets specific format requirements for the disclosure in images, video, and audio, and provides penalties for knowing and intentional violations. It also gives enforcement and investigation powers to the Attorney General and State's Attorneys, and allows candidates to seek injunctive relief.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Vermont. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
